data.content_ref: inline:SRC_004 and SRC_001 contradict each other on the role of checklist adherence because SRC_004 uses dissociation from the checklist on expert-strength items as the signal of competence, while SRC_001 assumes the panel relies on the checklist as a constraint and tests for genuine gain via error-set partitioning. This contradiction is REFUTED IF a third system that uses the checklist as a non-binding prompt (neither strict constraint nor fully dissociated) dominates both, demonstrating that the strict partition between compliance and competence is an experimental artifact.
